verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents that powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be submitted electronically to the tax office, and that organisations can name mailbox representatives (Postfachvertreter) who may view inbox messages. That gives a thin outline of authorization forms and one delegate role. Nothing in the evidence publishes a full scope of what a third party may or may not do, and nothing says which signatures or declarations stay personal. Missing for 10: published delegation scope (permitted vs. prohibited acts), the actual authorization form content, a full role catalogue beyond mailbox representatives, a statement of which signatures cannot be delegated, and independent corroboration.
